changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RollupPathLink') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathLink] ( [RollupPathUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [StartPosition] [int] NOT NULL, [EndPosition] [int] NULL, [IntersectTypeID] [int] NULL ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_MetricRollupPath') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathLink] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_MetricRollupPath] end
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricRollupPathLink_IntersectType') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathLink] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricRollupPathLink_IntersectType] end
if exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricRollupPathLink') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathLink] DROP CONSTRAINT PK_MetricRollupPathLink WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricRollupPathLink_IntersectType') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MetricRollupPathLink_IntersectType] ON [metrics].[RollupPathLink] ( [IntersectTypeID] ASC ) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricRollupPathLink_RollupPath') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MetricRollupPathLink_RollupPath] ON [metrics].[RollupPathLink] ( [RollupPathUid] ASC ) end
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricRollupPathLink_IntersectType') begin DROP INDEX [IX_MetricRollupPathLink_IntersectType] ON [metrics].[RollupPathLink] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricRollupPathLink_RollupPath') begin DROP INDEX [IX_MetricRollupPathLink_RollupPath] ON [metrics].[RollupPathLink] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
